definitions.recall_strict: attacks with a hold (severity >= HOLD) strictly before the attack's last event ÷ instances (§10.9)
definitions.recall_at_or_before: the same with the hold at or before the last event (a hold decided on the final transfer stops it)
definitions.early_detection_rate: attacks held strictly before the attack's FIRST transaction ÷ instances (no money attempted yet)
definitions.precision: alerted cases (any point with severity >= HOLD) holding this family's attack events ÷ (those + every alerted case holding no attack event). Benign false alarms are charged to every family, so this is a lower bound per family
definitions.false_positive_rate: benign customers with any case reaching HIGH ÷ benign customers (BenchmarkReport)
definitions.legit_payment_friction: benign transactions made while one of the customer's cases held or blocked payments ÷ all benign transactions (= BenchmarkReport.false_declines_rate); plus benign customers that got a step-up request and benign cases with a hold
definitions.lead_time_s: over strictly caught attacks: first S6 evidence (else the last event) − earliest intervention
definitions.money_prevented_paise: S6 amounts at or after the earliest intervention (strict and at-or-before views)

txn_model_ieee_cis.note: As measured, not tuned. A random scorer's PR-AUC equals the positive rate, so PR-AUC must be read against prevalence; the 11 TXN_FEATURES are bank-event features that IEEE-CIS card data mostly lacks.
